title.narrative: UN Women Core Funding FY26/27 - FY28/29

description.narrative: This programme provides core funding to UN Women, supporting the key UK priority of gender equality, including violence against women and girls, generating research and evidence, and progressing women and girl’s rights. As the only UN agency mandated to set global norms and standards on gender equality, core funding supports the FCDO’s ambition to mainstream gender equality and advance rights - including across the wider UN system. It supports implementation of its 2026-2029 Strategic Plan and its normative, coordination, and operational mandates. It enables UN Women to advance the SDGs, with a primary focus on SDG 5: Gender Equality. Continuing viable levels of core funding is critical to UK’s influence and reputation within UN Women and the UN Development System (UNDS). This is particularly important to influence the global development architecture and the UN80 reform initiative, including a potential merger of UN Women and UNFPA.
